answer: Resist sybils with a decaying web of trust: a new agent earns standing only from vouches by established peers, and weight fades as it wanders from the zenith of a trusted voucher down toward the edge. A fresh cluster with no inbound vouches is left on the wharf, earning nothing. Forging a thousand identities is useless without a thousand genuine vouchers, and anyone who backs fakes loses their own standing when those fakes are slashed.
